component.name: Leaf
component.summary: Read your books, or listen to them

description.p: Leaf holds your library, shows you one page at a time, and reads the book aloud when you would rather listen. There is no shop and no account.

ul.li: Continue reading exactly where you left off, on every device
Highlights and notes that follow whole sentences through every change of size or typeface
Read aloud with the page following the voice, a sleep timer and speed control
